nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Runs KB health check every 6 hours. Also accepts manual trigger.

nodes.name: Get KB Stats
nodes.notes: Fetches current knowledge base statistics: chunk count, sources, index size.

nodes.name: Generate Test Queries
nodes.notes: Selects 5 random baseline queries from a pool of 10 pharma/cyber questions.

nodes.name: Query RAG Pipeline
nodes.notes: Sends each test query through the full RAG pipeline (knowledge search + Ollama). Measures response quality.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemma2:9b', prompt: 'You are a quality evaluator. Rate the following Q&A pair on a scale of 1-10 for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.

Question: ' + $json.query + '
Answer: ' + ($json.response || $json.answer || 'NO_RESPONSE').substring(0, 3000) + '

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"score": <1-10>, "has_sources": <true/false>, "is_hallucination": <true/false>, "reason": "<brief reason>"}', stream: false, options: { temperature: 0.1 } }) }}

nodes.name: Score Response Quality
nodes.notes: Uses Ollama (low temp) to evaluate RAG response quality: score 1-10, hallucination check, source attribution.

nodes.name: Parse Quality Scores
nodes.notes: Parses Ollama quality evaluation into structured scores per query.

nodes.name: Get Dashboard Metrics
nodes.notes: Fetches current dashboard metrics for gap detection stats.

nodes.name: Build Health Report
nodes.notes: Aggregates per-query scores into overall health report: avg/min/max score, hallucination rate, gap stats.

nodes.name: Store Health Report
nodes.notes: POSTs the health report to PharmaLLM for storage and dashboard display.

nodes.name: Is Degraded?
nodes.notes: Routes to alert if health is degraded or unhealthy.

nodes.name: Generate Alert
nodes.notes: Generates actionable alert with specific recommendations when KB health is degraded.

nodes.name: Log Healthy
nodes.notes: Logs healthy status when no issues detected.
